hypotheses.claim: Issuer-level event can be joined as stock-level margin/short/borrow evidence

validationProtocol.PIT: Use each exact dated source vintage and firstKnownAt; 2026-10-10 retrieval is audit evidence, not a backdated decision receipt
validationProtocol.OOS: After exact-date identity certification and preregistration, use genuinely later independent TDCC vintage pairs; do not count 2778 symbols as 2778 independent dates
validationProtocol.walkForward: Purge overlapping target windows and embargo where necessary; freeze identity rules before outcome joins
validationProtocol.bias: Check survivorship, re-used identifiers, missingness, hindsight exclusions and corporate-action denominator drift
validationProtocol.multipleTesting: Register all feature, cutoff, subgroup and time-window variations; no post-hoc best-pick
validationProtocol.redundancy: Control direct price, volume, liquidity, institution, leverage, actual SBL short, ETF/index flow; deduplicate common primitive receipts
validationProtocol.cost: Check market venue, tradability, spread, slippage, borrow eligibility, fee, capacity and regime stratification
validationProtocol.regime: Stratify transfer/suspension, active/inactive markets and event days
validationProtocol.conclusion: Only source/semantic falsification. No realized returns, no L4, no ranking/BUY/SELL/production change.
